content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and the payer does not offer peer-to-peer review, so those routes are unavailable. Because a CO-197 denial is on the table, a formal appeal supported by the clinical necessity of monitoring for syncope and TIA is the only compliant action that can still pursue payer reimbursement; the authorization denial should not be shifted to the patient."}
